text: I can compute worst-case clock error from a drift rate and sync interval, and choose between a wall clock and a monotonic clock.
I can explain why NTP accuracy is bounded by path asymmetry and what slewing and stepping do to a clock.
I can assign Lamport timestamps to a message diagram and state exactly what they do and do not prove.
I can compute vector clocks for a sequence of events and identify which pairs are concurrent.
I can show with a timeline how clock skew makes last-write-wins lose data and propose a safer design.
I can explain what hybrid logical clocks and TrueTime commit wait each guarantee and cost.
